Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: System Event Messages signal events that affect the entire NASDAQ system.

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: An Add Order Message indicates that a new order has been accepted by the NASDAQ system and added onto the displayable book. It includes a day-unique Order Reference Number assigned by NASDAQ to the order.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to this new order. Increasing, but not necessarily sequential.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Total number of shares being added to the book (may be less than the number of shares entered).

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit price of the order.

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: "Y" = displayed in the quote. The "S" value is no longer supported as of the NASDAQ/INET merger.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part. The execution price is always equal to the limit price of the order as indicated in the Add Order Message.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The reference number of the order that was executed. References a previously sent Add Order Message.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The NASDAQ generated day-unique Match Number of this execution. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is modified as a result of being canceled in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The reference number of the order being canceled or reduced. References a previously sent Add Order Message.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: The Trade Message provides information about execution events that involve orders not visible on the NASDAQ book. A Trade Message is transmitted each time a hidden order is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The NASDAQ reference number of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: "B" = buy order executed. "S" = sell order executed.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol, right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The match price of the order.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The NASDAQ generated session-unique Match Number for this trade. The Match Number is referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Message.Name: Broken Trade Message
Message.Description: The Broken Trade message is sent whenever an execution on NASDAQ is broken.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The NASDAQ Match Number of the execution that was broken. This refers to a Match Number from a previously transmitted Order Modified - Execution Message or Trade Message.

Value.Name: Start of Day
Value.Description: This is always the first message sent in any trading day. It indicates that NASDAQ is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: End of Day
Value.Description: It indicates that NASDAQ is now closed and will not accept any new orders today. All orders that remain open in this session are now dead and can be purged from the book. It is still possible to receive Broken Trade Messages and Order Cancel Messages after the End of Day.
